_doc: Trạc Anh Đài lineage (rules-proposals R5), a no-lean body sect (R3): leans Water, Ice -> none. Outer gate: unbroken-flesh-canon (existing Yellow body). Inner gate and above: canglang-body-canon (proposal, Profound body). Secret arts: whale-line-harpoon (inner), hundred-echo-palm-scripture (existing; the Tê Nhạn abbey's palm, elders). Proposals are unpriced.

lineage.tree_route_note: Ice Pupil (Băng Đồng) and Spear Thrust (Thứ Thương): the frost-sea body (cold resistance, health) and the harpoon's thrust.

techniques.name: Canglang Washing Body Canon (Thương Lãng Trạc Thể Kinh)
techniques.concept: The founder's method, named for the old song: when the Canglang water is clear, wash your hat strings; when it is muddy, wash your feet. The disciple tempers the body in the frost sea, one dive deeper for each layer, and learns to take what the water gives: clear water washes the qi, muddy water hardens the skin. It runs on no element, so any fisher's child with good bones can learn it. In a fight it is endurance: health that rises when struck by cold or water, a grip that does not let go, and lungs that outlast the foe.

arts.concept: A breath held under pressure: for a few seconds the holder's health regenerates and cold damage taken is halved.
A low, rooted stance after being hit: the next hit taken is turned into body shield, and the holder cannot be knocked back.
At the ninth layer, once a fight: the holder sinks into the stillness of deep water, takes no damage for 1 s and clears every slowing effect.

techniques.lore: Khuất Thanh Anh made it in 830 from the way the frost-coast seal hunters had always trained their sons: into the sea in winter, and out again before the heart stops.

techniques.name: Whale-Line Harpoon Rite (Kình Tác Lao Pháp)
techniques.concept: The sea hunters' harpoon art: a thrown iron on a qi-woven line that pins, then drags. The hunter fights tethered to the foe, closes the distance by hauling, and finishes at arm's length with the body canon's grip. It is a force art and takes no element, only a strong back.

arts.concept: A ranged throw that pins the target: their movement and art speed fall while the line holds.
Drags a pinned target to the holder and deals Physical damage scaled by how long the line held.

techniques.lore: Taught only on the terrace, with the line made from the founder's whale sinew, which has not frayed in 370 years.
